title: tell company (api/v0/companies/{domain}.json)
description: The per-domain contract of docs/SPEC.md section 9, plus `why_not_higher` (signals whose contribution decayed to zero in the last 30 days). Dates are ISO 8601 calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Money never appears as a field here; wherever the static API carries an amount (weekly top lists) it is an integer number of US dollars. Every contribution and every decayed signal carries a non-empty receipt `url`. `heat` is present only when the object is served through a watchlist (api/v0/watchlists/{slug}.json). `score` is the raw sum of decayed contributions rounded to one decimal; `contributions[].contribution` values are rounded to one decimal with largest-remainder apportionment so that they add up to `score` exactly.

profile.description: ICP profile the score is computed under.

score.description: Raw sum of decayed contributions, one decimal.

heat.description: Percentile rank of the raw score within the watchlist; only present when served through a watchlist.

contributions.description: One entry per signal with a positive decayed contribution, largest first.

open_postings.description: Open postings on the company's boards.

ats.description: `vendor:identifier` of the active job board, or `no_board`.

news.description: A company feed or any news event is known.

generated_by.description: URL of the code commit that produced the file, or `local` for a local build.

why_not_higher.description: Extension to the section 9 example: signals whose contribution decayed to zero in the last 30 days, most recently decayed first.

postings.description: The counted postings behind a hiring_velocity contribution.
